rationale: Clear motor-vehicle collision claim: rear-end impact causing totaled vehicle and injury to policyholder.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report. High-severity claim with significant vehicle damage and bodily injury requiring prompt adjuster attention.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle at ~35 mph; other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Entire trunk crushed into back seat; vehicle totaled
case_facts.police_report: Other driver's insurance info documented on police report
